lede: Wesley Chapel does Christmas with light shows at The Shops at Wiregrass, a neighborhood party at Avalon Park and Santa on the ice at AdventHealth Center Ice.
celebrates: The Shops at Wiregrass, which calls itself the downtown of Wesley Chapel, hosts the Symphony in Lights tree light shows with snowfall every season, with shows at 6, 7, 8 and 9 pm. Avalon Park Wesley Chapel holds Avalon Aglow, a free celebration with pictures with Santa, vendors, live music, a bounce park and fireworks. AdventHealth Center Ice runs its 9th Annual Winter Wonderland with holiday public skates, a tree decorating contest and Skate with Santa Claus sessions for all ages.
lastyear: Last season, a Wesley Chapel District Park listing shows a Winter Wonderland on Saturday, December 13, 2025, from 4 to 8 pm at the park on Boyette Road, according to a Fun 4 Tampa Kids calendar post. Wesley Chapel Now, a local news site, noted that the town centers, not the city, run the holidays here because there is no Wesley Chapel Christmas parade. We list only events with a 2026 host page.
facts: AdventHealth Center Ice's page calls this its 9th Annual Winter Wonderland, and the rink's season tree contest runs November 23 to January 8 with proceeds going to Champions For Children. The Shops at Wiregrass says on its own site that it hosts more than 100 events a year. Avalon Park Wesley Chapel lists Avalon Aglow with a fireworks finale.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Wesley Chapel itself. The nearest rail history on this site is the Henry B. Plant Museum in Tampa, a former hotel built for the railroad era. Our Tampa and Spring Hill pages list holiday train and trolley options in the wider Tampa Bay area, and the Pasco side of the county has train rides at New Port Richey's tree lighting.

faq: How does Wesley Chapel celebrate Christmas?

Is there a free Christmas event in Wesley Chapel?
Avalon Aglow is free and open to the public, according to Avalon Park Wesley Chapel. Each listing on this page shows the host's cost, and the Symphony in Lights page shows no price.
Where can kids meet Santa in Wesley Chapel?

Avalon Aglow lists pictures with Santa, and AdventHealth Center Ice has Skate with Santa Claus on December 5 and 19. The New River Branch Library has a Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus storytime special listed on this page.

We did not find one. The closest rail history on this site is in Tampa, and New Port Richey's Light Up the Night tree lighting has train rides. See those pages for dates.
